name: Marshall Islands

flag.description: A blue field with two diagonal stripes, orange above white, widening as they rise from the lower hoist to the upper fly, and a white 24-pointed star in the upper hoist.
flag.symbolism: The blue is the Pacific; the white stripe stands for the Ratak (sunrise) chain and peace, the orange for the Ralik (sunset) chain and courage, and the star's 24 points for the municipalities.

hook: An orange-and-white ray sweeps up across blue towards a 24-pointed star: the Marshall Islands' two island chains, Ratak (sunrise) and Ralik (sunset).
trivia: The flag was designed by Emlain Kabua, wife of the country's first president, Amata Kabua.
Bikini Atoll was the site of US nuclear tests from 1946 to 1958, and the swimsuit was named after it in 1946.
